source_note: Curated by hand from the official scheme guidelines (jansuraksha.gov.in, npscra.nsdl.co.in, pmjdy.gov.in, and the India Post Sukanya Samriddhi rules). This is a LOCAL dataset, not a live government API. Premium and cover amounts are the figures notified as of the as_of date and must still be reconfirmed at the bank before enrolling.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
schemes.benefit: A basic bank account with no minimum balance, a free RuPay debit card, up to two lakh rupees accident insurance on the card, and an overdraft facility of up to ten thousand rupees for eligible accounts.
schemes.eligibility_spoken: Any Indian citizen aged ten or above can open one. You do not need an existing bank account, this is how you get one.
documents: Aadhaar card, or any one officially valid document like voter ID, driving licence, or passport
If you have no valid document, a small-account can still be opened with a self-attested photo and signature or thumb impression

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
schemes.benefit: Life insurance cover of two lakh rupees paid to your family if the policyholder passes away, for any reason.
schemes.premium: Around four hundred thirty six rupees per year, auto-debited from your bank account.
schemes.eligibility_spoken: For people aged eighteen to fifty who have a savings bank account and agree to yearly auto-debit of the premium.
documents: Aadhaar card linked to that account
A signed consent form for yearly auto-debit of the premium

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
schemes.benefit: Accident insurance of two lakh rupees for death or full disability, and one lakh rupees for partial disability, from an accident.
schemes.premium: Just twenty rupees per year, auto-debited from your bank account.
schemes.eligibility_spoken: For people aged eighteen to seventy who have a savings bank account and agree to yearly auto-debit of the premium.
documents: Aadhaar card linked to that account
A signed consent form for yearly auto-debit of the premium

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana
schemes.benefit: A guaranteed monthly pension of one thousand to five thousand rupees after you turn sixty, depending on how much you contribute now.
schemes.premium: A small monthly contribution based on your age and chosen pension amount.
schemes.eligibility_spoken: For people aged eighteen to forty who have a savings bank account. The younger you join, the smaller your monthly contribution.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.benefit: A long-term savings account for a girl child that earns a high, government-set interest rate, with tax benefits. It can be used later for her education or marriage.
schemes.eligibility_spoken: For a girl child below ten years of age. A parent or guardian opens and runs the account for her at a bank or post office.
documents: The parent or guardian's identity proof, like Aadhaar
The parent or guardian's address proof
